report.headline: 18-year-old high-usage EuroLeague scorer projected for a smaller but still above-average NBA role

projection.text: The model projects a 23.2% usage rate in the NBA, above the league's 20.0% average but well below his 28.9% usage in the EuroLeague.

risks.text: Half of his shot attempts came from three-point range, a heavy reliance on one shot type that may not hold up as his role changes.
The true shooting projection of 55.3% should not be trusted: on this metric the model's out-of-fold error (4.7%) is no better than the trivial league-average baseline (4.7%).
Even the more reliable usage projection carries wide uncertainty: the 95% interval spans 15.3% to 31.2%, covering most of the plausible NBA usage range.
The estimate rests on only 61 historical EuroLeague-to-NBA transitions.

strengths.text: At just 18.0 years old, he produced 22.241 points, 5.97 assists, and 6.727 rebounds per 75 possessions in the EuroLeague.
His EuroLeague usage rate of 28.9% sat 1.85 standard deviations above that league's average, reflecting a heavy offensive role for his team.
He paired a 29.8% assist rate with a modest 15.0% turnover rate.
His true shooting percentage of 61.2% was 0.39 standard deviations above the EuroLeague average.

uncertainty.text: The 80% prediction interval for usage runs from 18.0% to 28.5%, a span of roughly two full standard deviations of NBA usage (5.2%), so the model can flag him as a plausible above-average-usage player but cannot say where in that range he will actually land.
